official.tuition_coverage_note: The benefit finances all or part of the annual tuition (arancel anual) of a regular undergraduate degree at an institution accredited as at 31 December 2026. The amount depends on the institution and the type of degree: Council of Rectors universities finance the annual reference tuition (arancel de referencia anual) through 250 places of the Beca Bicentenario; other accredited institutions finance the annual tuition up to a maximum of CLP 1,150,000 through 250 places of the Beca Juan Gómez Millas; technical or professional degrees taught by institutes finance between CLP 600,000 and CLP 860,000 through 250 places of the Beca Nuevo Milenio. The caps concern tuition only; the annual arancel does not include the enrolment fee (matrícula).
official.funding_period: per academic year (maximum, varies by institution)

applicant_utility.summary: This is not a standalone scholarship but a reserved block of 750 places inside three existing Mineduc tuition scholarships, so your award depends entirely on which institution and which kind of degree you enrol in: a Council of Rectors university pays your full annual reference tuition, an accredited private university or CFT/IP pays up to CLP 1,150,000, and a technical/professional degree at an institute pays between CLP 600,000 and CLP 860,000. The benefit covers tuition only, never the matrícula (enrolment fee), materials, transport or living costs, so you must plan for those yourself. The application runs exclusively through the FUAS between 1 and 22 October 2026 for the 2027 intake, and the grant is decided on FUAS data plus State records rather than on any score you can prepare at the last minute. Be aware that having previously used Gratuidad for a degree blocks this benefit for that same degree, and that two prior Mineduc tuition scholarships disqualify you.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Chilean undergraduates with a disability registered in the RND, from the bottom 70% of the RSH, with a secondary-school average of 5.0+ and no prior higher qualification, enrolling face-to-face at an accredited institution.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your Registro Social de Hogares tramo in Mi ChileAtiende with RUN and ClaveÚnica before applying, since the 70% most vulnerable cut-off is applied on that register and not on what you type into FUAS
Confirm your RND (Registro Nacional de Discapacidad) registration is valid through 31 December 2026 before you file - re-registering after that date will not help this cycle
Get ClaveÚnica activated in advance if you do not already have FUAS credentials, as the FUAS portal needs one of the two to log in
Look up the degree's reference arancel and the institution's accreditation status on the Mineduc acceso site so you know which of the three underlying scholarships you would fall into
Complete the FUAS thoroughly and consistently with your household's actual composition, since the income calculation uses your family group and the characteristics of every member
Prepare the enrolment proof (comprobante de matrícula) showing the degree and the annual arancel for 2027 as soon as you are admitted
common_rejection_risks: Enrolling in a distance or non-presencial undergraduate programme, which the programme excludes outright
Choosing an institution or programme that is not accredited as at 31 December 2026
Applying for a degree you previously studied under Gratuidad, which is expressly forbidden
Letting the RND registration lapse so that it is not valid on 31 December 2026
Having already received two separate Mineduc tuition scholarships, or two as a first-year student
Missing the document-upload window on the FUAS site even though the application itself was filed on time
Assuming the award follows your grades: allocation is capped at 750 places and bounded by the budget law, so meeting every requirement does not guarantee a place
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Enrolment fee (matrícula), materials, transport and all living costs are not covered; at Council of Rectors universities any amount by which the real arancel exceeds the published reference arancel also stays with the student.
document_audit: The comprobante de matrícula must expressly show the degree and the annual arancel for the admission year - an invoice or a simple enrolment confirmation without the arancel will not do
Documents must be uploaded as PDFs on the FUAS site during Mineduc's own upload window, not attached at the moment you file the application
Your licence/record of enseñanza media must support the 5.0 average you claim; the FUAS data is cross-checked against State records
Keep the RND certificate and the RSH household printout ready as the two documents outside the FUAS that prove your eligibility
alerts: The 2027 application window closes 22 October 2026 and there is no late route published for the first period

Dates after 22 October 2026 are fixed: socioeconomic information 17 December 2026, pre-selection results 15 January 2027, assignment results 10 March 2027, appeals 10-25 March 2027 - build your enrolment decision around them
Call Ayuda Mineduc on 600 600 26 26 early if any document is unclear; the window is short and the ChileAtiende helpdesk cannot process FUAS uploads
Do not let an admitted student combine this with Gratuidad or another Mineduc tuition scholarship for the same degree - the rule is enforced on prior receipt of arancel scholarships

applicant_utility.summary: This is a legal entitlement under Ley N° 19.992 rather than a competition, so there is no socioeconomic test, no PSU/PDT/PAES score and no grade cut-off - what decides your outcome is documentary, not academic. Which route you are on changes the amount completely: a titular named in the Valech report gets the enrolment fee plus the entire annual tuition, whereas a grandchild using a transferred benefit at a private university or a professional institute is capped at CLP 1,150,000 and at a technical centre or technical degree at CLP 600,000. The application is filed on the FUAS between 1 and 22 October 2026 for the 2027 intake, and the transfer forms must be notarised, which is the step that most often runs out of time. If the holder died, the specific anexo you need (1, 2 or 3) depends on whether a transfer was executed in life and whether posesión efectiva has been granted - picking the wrong one stalls the whole file.
applicant_utility.best_fit: People individualised in the Informe Comisión Valech, or their children and grandchildren using a transferred benefit, who need tuition and enrolment covered without any income or grade test.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm the holder's status in the Informe Comisión Valech through the INDH listing and that no other family member has already drawn the benefit, as that voids the traspaso route

Identify your exact documentary route before you start: titular, traspaso with a living holder, traspaso with a deceased holder with a previously executed transfer, traspaso with posesión efectiva, or traspaso without it
Book a notary appointment early for anexo N° 1, 2 or 3 - notarisation is unavoidable and the FUAS window is only three weeks
Obtain the certificado de defunción and, where relevant, the posesión efectiva resolution from the Juzgado de Letras en lo Civil or the Registro Civil in advance

Check the accreditation status of the institution (and of the degree itself if you are entering Medicina, Pedagogía or Odontología) on the Mineduc acceso site, since accredited status is required as at 31 December 2026 for second-year and traspaso routes and 31 January 2027 for those three degrees
Scan every document to PDF before the window opens, including both sides of the cédula de identidad
Also complete the general FUAS form, which the awarding body recommends because it opens the Junaeb Beca de Alimentación
common_rejection_risks: Using the wrong anexo (1, 2 or 3) for the holder's actual situation, or submitting a transfer form that was never notarised
A family member having already taken the benefit, which blocks the traspaso route at the time of application
Applying through traspaso into an institution that is not accredited as at 31 December 2026
Entering Medicina, Pedagogía or Odontología where the degree itself is not accredited or in process as at 31 January 2027
Holding a professional or technical degree of higher level, or a terminal licenciatura
Having received two separate Mineduc tuition scholarships previously
Enrolling in a distance or non-presencial undergraduate programme
Uploading a comprobante de matrícula that does not state the degree and the annual arancel for the year
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: All living costs, materials and transport; in the traspaso route at private universities and professional institutes, the part of the arancel above CLP 1,150,000, and at technical centres and technical degrees the part above CLP 600,000, plus any difference between the real arancel and the published reference arancel at Council of Rectors universities.
document_audit: The transfer forms (anexos 1, 2, 3) and the anexo 5 carta de aceptación must be legalised before a notary - an unnotarised scan is the single most common failure
Cédulas de identidad must be copied on both sides, including the holder's where the route requires it
The licencia de enseñanza media must be a legalised photocopy for the traspaso route, not a plain copy
Where the holder is the applicant's grandmother or grandfather, you must additionally produce the certificado de nacimiento of the applicant's parent to prove the family line
Every document goes in as PDF on the FUAS site, so keep the originals accessible for any later verification
alerts: The application window for admisión 2027 closes 22 October 2026 and the notarisation requirement means you should start at least several weeks earlier

For a deceased holder, the transfer must have been executed in life by notarial document for descendants beyond a second-degree lineal relative to qualify, so an informal family promise has no legal standing
Fixed dates after 22 October 2026: socioeconomic information 17 December 2026, pre-selection results 15 January 2027, assignment results 10 March 2027, appeals 10-25 March 2027
Only 24 days separate the close of applications from the socioeconomic information date, so do not leave document uploads until after the deadline
Call Ayuda Mineduc on 600 600 26 26 for route clarification; the ChileAtiende 101 line cannot resolve FUAS document questions
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the specific benefit form on the FUAS site during the application window, upload the notarised route-specific PDFs during Mineduc's upload dates, enrol at the qualifying institution, then follow the assignment result on resultados.beneficiosestudiantiles.cl.
